meta.description: Plot per-gene mutation distributions on protein-domain maps with maftools, trackViewer, and g3viz.
meta.audit_type: focused final-pass re-audit at the exact follow-up commit
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md
meta.execution_note: The exact follow-up commit changes only the TP53 feature-attribution prose and matching labels/comments. Focused verification parsed the committed R example and confirmed that SKILL.md, usage-guide.md, and the example consistently distinguish current UniProt features from the conventional 102--292 DNA-binding-core range. The unchanged runtime paths retain the 7/7 execution evidence from parent corrective commit e526c0d363d7c07ed2c923074217f6689282564b (maftools 2.22.0, trackViewer 1.42.0, g3viz 1.2.0). Source was not written.
